edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your clearest window. With full kit and W healing, extended trades favour you — she needs Mist to survive your chain autos, but Mist has a cooldown and she cannot sit inside it forever while you reset with W. Aim to hook her AFTER the Mist expires: bait it with a chain Q toward her, wait the three seconds, then E in and convert the free trade. At 6 you steal Needlework, which adds poke pressure but is not the matchup-defining swing it is against Malphite or Sion — her R is solid, not broken on Sylas. Still, use the level-6 window to force another all-in while your lead is intact; she transitions toward her spike faster than you do.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your clearest window. With full kit and W healing, extended trades favour you — she needs Mist to survive your chain autos, but it is 22 seconds at rank 1 and she cannot sit in it forever while you reset with W. Aim to hook her after the Mist drops: bait it with a chain Q toward her, and if you must contest early, step inside the mist, because only enemies standing in it can target her. At 6 you steal Needlework, which adds poke pressure but is not the matchup-defining swing it is against Malphite or Sion — her R is solid, not broken on Sylas. Still, use the level-6 window to force another all-in while your lead is intact; she transitions toward her spike faster than you do.
